newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy says to keep monetary policy tight.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy says to keep monetary policy tight.

text.p: Italian monetary policy will remain aimed at pushing average inflation below three percent in 1997, the Bank of Italy said in a statement.

"The recent relaxation of money market rates has taken into account the slowdown in prices already seen this year. Monetary policy maintains a restrictive trend needed to continue and consolidate these events," the statement said.
